<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Peterson elimination, which in the forward direction breaks a C‑Si bond (6‑14) and a C‑O bond (6‑8) and changes a C‑C single bond (6‑6) to a double bond (order change 1.0→2.0). Using these bond change criteria should retrieve the appropriate template ID, after which we can apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "bonds_broken": ["6-14", "6-8"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (1.0->2.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
